patterns.name: Radix threshold ladder
patterns.rule: Use b^k boundaries as discrete scale events or shell indices.

patterns.name: Active-bit pulse simplex
patterns.rule: Embed sparse active positions as a chosen simplex or regular polygon while retaining bit positions as metadata.

patterns.name: Pascal parity mask
patterns.rule: Generate a Sierpinski occupancy mask with exact parity tests; do not claim generic power-of-two rows are all odd.

patterns.name: Dutch teen suffix hinge
patterns.rule: Represent morphological order separately from decimal place order.

patterns.name: Dutch en-order hinge
patterns.rule: Insert a connector node and perform a two-component semantic transposition.

patterns.name: Cut-open boundary graph
patterns.rule: Change a loop constraint into an open path with explicit endpoint identity.

patterns.name: Loop-to-leg morph
patterns.rule: Interpolate curve controls while separately recording the topology event.

patterns.name: Split-oval antisymmetry
patterns.rule: Use a fixed center node and opposite signed displacement fields.

patterns.name: Overlap-lens domain
patterns.rule: Treat overlap as geometry, tolerance, blend or join domain only after semantics are declared.

patterns.name: SDF-zero event
patterns.rule: Promote a boundary crossing from sampling detail to event semantics.

patterns.name: Cone support gate
patterns.rule: Prune by radial and angular support before relation solving.

patterns.name: Nested-shell relevance
patterns.rule: Use concentric intervals as local multiscale support, not global identity.

patterns.name: Mobius orientation wrap
patterns.pipeline: boundary crossing -> coordinate wrap + orientation flip
patterns.rule: Implement non-orientability as an explicit quotient map.

patterns.name: Klein sheet wrap
patterns.pipeline: boundary crossing -> wrap + orientation and sheet update
patterns.rule: Keep projected self-intersection distinct from state coupling.

patterns.name: Hourglass route table
patterns.rule: Route through a finite four-sector table.

patterns.name: Log-polar bitmask
patterns.pipeline: Cartesian point -> core flag, rho, theta -> sector bit
patterns.rule: Use a compact local admission mask with explicit dimensions and singular core.

patterns.name: Golden-angle schedule
patterns.rule: Use as a sample schedule only; no zero-aliasing or zero-cost claim.

patterns.name: Bounded grammar recursion
patterns.rule: Stop on depth, symbol, expression or cycle limits.

patterns.name: Event-latched field morph
patterns.rule: Keep visual interpolation and committed topology state separate.

patterns.name: Content-addressed definition graph
patterns.rule: Make the substrate carry and verify its own operator definitions.
